items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson: Caleb Williams week-to-week with hamstring (MRI Monday), expectation he will likely miss some time; same left hamstring as college injury.
items.why: Hamstring pull on scramble; carted off, walking later.
items.opportunity: Bagent opportunity; CHI WR/RB volume may shift.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels suffered another dislocated left elbow, ruled out; X-rays negative, expected to miss time (last instance ~1 month).
items.why: Dislocated left elbow on awkward fall; similar to prior injury.
items.implication: Miss multiple weeks; backup QB elevated role, Commanders pass game uncertain.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/snaps for WAS WRs/TEs if volume holds.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially ACTIVE; optimism pregame, to wear flak jacket.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily; no WR elevated.
items.implication: Full or near-full role expected in LAC offense.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining DEN RBs.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) will have MRI today; hope minor as he played through it after missing most of first half.
items.implication: Likely short-term if minor; monitor MRI.

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan: Mike Evans hip injury not believed serious; could have returned in 4th if needed. Demarcus Robinson high ankle sprain.
items.why: Hip; not expected serious per coach.

items.text: Raiders HC Klint Kubiak on Brock Bowers: 'Close, very close. He looks great.'
items.opportunity: TE1 role resumption; Mayer snaps reverse.

items.text: Sunday injuries watching: Williams hamstring, Daniels elbow, Barkley stinger, Price chest, Reed head, Brooks groin, Dowdle toe, Jones knee, Dobbins ham, Goedert knee, Evans hip (not serious), Njoku/Kolar, etc.
items.implication: Multiple high-value players in flux for ROS.

items.text: ETR weekend summary: McConkey GTD optimism (flak), Nacua GTD hip, Harvey not expected, Olave/Burrow expected, Flowers/Pittman OUT.
Rams consider Puka Nacua (hip) a pre-game decision for MNF; questionable, different injury than camp psoas.
items.implication: Monitor warmups; backup WRs/TEs if out.
items.opportunity: If out, TE heavy or other WRs bump.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell: out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12; opportunities 36-12 through 2 weeks. Tucker active but 0 snaps.
items.implication: Irving locked as RB1; Gainwell limited.
items.opportunity: High snap share, goal-line/3rd down potential.

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in 31 games), punished in playing time; NE needs TreVeyon Henderson explosiveness especially with AJ Brown out.
items.implication: Henderson more involved even if Stevenson not fumbling.

items.text: DeVonta Smith RIDE OR DIE: 27%/38% target shares first two games; leads all WRs in expected PPR points this week per model.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. down to 0.53 YPRR this season; only a few WRs worse.
items.why: Extremely poor yards per route run.
